args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.halvorsen.example/2026/warehouse and its companion piece (https://insights.halvorsen.example/warehouse/companion):

• Pick rates rose 18% in 2026 with the rollout of autonomous carts.
• Integration took twice as long as planned, so timelines for automation projects should be padded accordingly.
• The biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks, not from raw throughput gains.
args.title: Warehouse Automation 2026 — Halvorsen Blog Summary
